🔥 Your energy bill goes up £60 on 1 October. Then it's forecast to go up again.

Ofgem has confirmed the cap rises 4% to £1,723 next month. Cornwall Insight — the analysts the whole industry watches — expect a further 9% rise in January, to around £1,872. That's another £149, landing in the coldest, most expensive month of the year. Ofgem confirms the January figure by 25 November.

The government's VAT cut on electricity is worth about £45 a year. One quarterly increase has already swallowed it. 👇
